title: 达布：上和与下和什么时候一致

claims.statement: Darboux Mémoire sur les fonctions discontinues 1875 Annales ENS série2 vol4 pages57–112
original p65 defines upper M, lower m, oscillation Δ sums with Δ=M−m
original p70 Δ_ab=0 iff limits of upper and lower sums coincide
for bounded real f partition P defines Mi=sup f on interval, mi=inf f, U=ΣMiΔx and L=ΣmiΔx
claims.locator: historical formula translated into modern notation

claims.statement: every tagged Riemann sum lies between L(P) and U(P)
refining a partition does not increase U or decrease L
bounded f on closed interval Riemann integrable iff for each ε>0 exists P U−L<ε
single-step f=0 left half,1 right half has U−L≤2mesh and integral1/2
claims.locator: only intervals incident to x=1/2 contribute oscillation

claims.statement: Dirichlet 1_Q on [0,1] has U=1 L=0 for any finite partition
claims.locator: density of rational and irrational points

claims.statement: Thomae function 1/q at reduced p/q and0 on irrational, discontinuous at all rational yet Riemann integrable
claims.locator: modern function theorem and denominator property

claims.statement: Thomae upper sums <ε using finite set q≤N enclosed in short intervals and remaining bound≤1/(N+1)
claims.locator: finite spike cover with total length<ε/2

claims.statement: Darboux intermediate value property of derivatives is distinct from upper/lower sum integrability
Darboux x-axis interval partition contrasts Lebesgue 1901 division by y-values and measure

caveats: Darboux original pages p65/p70 verified with PDF screenshots; modern notation clearly marked.
Use bounded f on closed interval for Darboux criterion; do not claim all functions on arbitrary domains.
Derivative intermediate-value Darboux theorem is another result, not same as integral criterion.
Thomae proof selects finite high spikes and covers in short partition cells; not just counts discontinuities.
Workflow gates and independent review still pending.
